description: This file defines the AccountsParseRule class, which extends BaseRule, and implements pre-processing logic for panel data structures in the context of rendering account views in SuiteCRM. It modifies panel data by transforming certain identifiers and processing custom code blocks related to address fields and parent identifiers.

classes.name: AccountsParseRule
classes.description: A class that extends BaseRule to implement pre-parse modifications to panels for account views within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Processes panels data, modifies parent_id fields to parent_name and updates address fields with custom code references.
